meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭出符合约定的可渲染合成结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要编排多素材画面并需要一个稳定可复用的创作约定。
copy.tagline_en: Set up media scenes that follow clear timing and rendering rules.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build layered compositions and want stable, predictable rendering.

howto.what: 让Claude按HyperFrames规范把网页代码编排成可播放的视频项目:安排画面和声音的起止时间、嵌套与组合多个子项目、设定复用变量,并让每次渲染结果一致。
howto.when: 当用户要求用HyperFrames制作或调整视频项目时触发,例如设定片段播放时间、嵌套子项目、配置媒体等。

say.text: 帮我用HyperFrames做一个10秒的图文动画项目。
say.note: 他会给出带时间属性的组合HTML。

say.text: 在这个组合里让主视频从第2秒播到第8秒。
say.note: 将调整片段的起止时间属性。

say.text: 检查我的子项目接线和媒体ID是否合规。
say.note: 可发现嵌套计时、缺失ID等格式问题。

howto.what_en: Guides Claude in building a renderable HyperFrames project from an HTML composition: timing elements, nesting sub-compositions, setting variables, and keeping renders deterministic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or adjust a HyperFrames project, e.g. setting clip timing, wiring sub-compositions, or configuring media.

say_en.text: Make a 10-second graphic+text animation project with HyperFrames.
say_en.note: Produces composition HTML with timing attributes.

say_en.text: In this composition, let the main video play from second 2 to second 8.
Check that my sub-composition wiring and media IDs are compliant.
say_en.note: Can find nested timing or missing ID issues.
